tests.title: PC-CF orthotropic tensile/compressive/shear characterization
tests.acceptance_applied: Measured constitutive inputs, positive-definite reciprocal elastic model and directional allowables; no universal 63 MPa allowable. Sample count/statistical allowables must be frozen before qualification.

tests.title: M4 insert/boss pull-out and torque, boss/gusset subassembly
tests.acceptance_applied: Capacity must exceed solved interface demands with LC-specific margins 2.0 for LC1, 1.5 for LC2/LC3/LC4/LC6. Absolute pull-out/torque limits OPEN until insert geometry and FEA demand exist.

tests.title: M1D return-root/subassembly stiffness correlation
tests.acceptance_applied: Correlate same load/constraint arrangement to FEA, then calibrate and rerun. Correlation tolerance and allowable permanent set OPEN.

tests.title: ASA vent dimensional coupons, H/V orientation
tests.acceptance_applied: No cracks, incomplete webs or fused slots; measured width/position/warp error sum <=1.0 mm per Rev.W. Full shell warp still required.

tests.title: ASA Rev.EQ stepped-cell print and flow coupons
tests.acceptance_applied: No fused/closed passage, detached wall or support residue; verify every passage physically. Tolerance and pressure-loss acceptance OPEN pending qualified process and CFD; nominal 1 mm walls and 2 mm gaps are design dimensions, not tolerances.

tests.title: ASA/PC-CF retention datum coupon pair and full six-node metrology
tests.acceptance_applied: Determine spacer/compliant trim from measured gaps; no release of fixed 1 mm limiter from CAD. Five pilot specimens do not establish Cp/Cpk.

tests.title: 4x2 N45 magnet/steel target matrix
tests.acceptance_applied: Nominal mean 2.8..3.5 N/station; no tested nominal room-temperature station <2.5 N; independently measure 20..30 N for assembled eight-station front. Ten-station fallback requires repeat whole-frame verification.

tests.title: Complete-front peel and thermal retention
tests.acceptance_applied: Hand peel without tools, damage, DML contact or magnet/target release. Numerical peel-force limit and qualified hot condition OPEN; do not use catalogue magnet maximum temperature as operating target.

tests.title: Qualified mount-node/frame LC1-LC7 correlation
tests.acceptance_applied: LC1 mount displacement <=0.5 mm; LC4 corner normal displacement <=1 mm; no disengagement/unstable failure. Coupons, interface model, allowable strength and FEA margins must be qualified first; wall-anchor/substrate qualification is separate.

tests.title: Exact DAEX25FHE-4/component/connector/harness metrology
tests.acceptance_applied: Update authoritative DMU from measured/supplier dimensions; envelope <=320x400x40; fabric-DML nominal gap 2.8 mm and minimum 2.0 mm; no DML notches. Legacy EX25FHE2 naming does not authorize a device substitution.

tests.title: Thermal/airflow correlation
tests.acceptance_applied: Correlate CFD01-CFD05 and material/emissivity model; component temperature/derating limits OPEN until exact loss/junction/PCB models. SHT45 is not internal junction telemetry.

tests.title: Assembled DML/vents/acoustic attenuation
tests.acceptance_applied: Validate LC filter against mounted two-exciter series impedance; establish frequency-dependent acoustic limits before qualification. Geometric LOS blockage does not establish attenuation.

tests.title: Assembled Wi-Fi/BLE and radar/radome qualification
tests.acceptance_applied: Exact RF keepouts respected; controlled reference/golden-unit limits OPEN before qualification. No carbon-filled frame or distributed metal hardware permitted in authoritative masks without RF evidence.

tests.title: Electrical and firmware qualification
tests.acceptance_applied: External 24 V and PoE paths tested; continuous PoE application budget <=22.5 W. Numeric rail/SOA/thermal/EMC limits derive from verified schematics, datasheets and PCB, not guessed values.

tests.title: Every-unit factory sequence and pilot yield
tests.acceptance_applied: All mandatory tests PASS with traceable UUID record; no valid microphone stream when privacy OFF or MCU reset; corrupted application recoverable through GPIO0/CHIP_PU ROM path. Golden-unit windows and microphone collapse timeout OPEN until measured.

tests.title: PC-CF perimeter C-section versus X-braced subassembly process and stiffness comparison
tests.acceptance_applied: No missing/detached braces or blocked test interfaces. Define laboratory load protocol, sample count, allowable dimensional error and correlation tolerance before qualification. Measure stiffness in the relevant print orientation and 23/50/70 C conditions; do not infer product capacity from these fixture coupons. Rerun the actual frame model with calibrated material/interface data.
